# Modern Designer MS Main Gate – Geometric Art Design

Give your property a bold and luxurious entrance with this exclusive Modern Designer MS Main Gate by Harichand Steel.

This stunning double-leaf main gate features an elegant geometric circular pattern combined with vertical metal bars, creating a unique contemporary architectural design. The rich bronze-brown finish adds a premium appearance, while the decorative concentric circles and stylish golden-finish handles enhance its sophisticated look.

Designed to complement modern villas, luxury homes, and premium residential properties, this gate offers an excellent combination of strength, security, durability, and modern aesthetics.

Key Features

Heavy-duty MS (Mild Steel) construction.

Unique geometric circular designer pattern.

Modern vertical metal bar detailing.

Premium bronze-brown finish.

Stylish golden-finish long handles.

Strong and durable double-opening design.

Customized sizes, designs, and finishing options are available.

Harichand Steel is a trusted manufacturer of premium designer main gates, MS gates, stainless steel gates, aluminum profile gates, railings, and customized metal fabrication solutions in Delhi.
